contacts.supervision_evidence: No formal doctoral supervision role identified; approach as a practice/design-critique conversation.
contacts.unknowns: Availability, project/case-study access and interest in advising are unconfirmed. Contact is the general office; direct personal email was not established.

contacts.name: Yoshiharu Tsukamoto
contacts.institution: Institute of Science Tokyo, School of Environment and Society / Atelier Bow-Wow
contacts.role: Professor; architect and Atelier Bow-Wow co-founder
contacts.category: Potential doctoral supervisor or external advisor
contacts.evidence: Science Tokyo’s current profile names architectural design and behaviorology. The lab and university research account connect community fieldwork with spatial design.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could provide an architectural foundation for observation, thresholds, everyday coexistence and why physical presence matters; strong methods conversation before choosing technical infrastructure.
contacts.first_ask: How would architectural behaviorology frame a comparison of conventional and delegated civic-building thresholds without assuming a robot-centred solution?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Listed in Science Tokyo’s September 2026 doctoral faculty roster. The lab’s 2026 page directs admissions enquiries through its general process and says it cannot respond individually by email/phone on admissions.
contacts.unknowns: Follow the published admissions/information-session process for degree enquiries. The 2026 visits and September intake are past, and next-cycle dates, capacity, language and funding are unconfirmed. No current direct email recorded.

contacts.name: Yosuke Mano
contacts.institution: Institute of Science Tokyo, School of Environment and Society
contacts.role: Professor; urban design and community planning research
contacts.category: Potential doctoral supervisor or external advisor
contacts.evidence: An official 2026 university conference account identifies him as a Science Tokyo professor. A partner’s 2025 project record credits Mano Lab with participatory workshops for a community salon.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could bring participatory fieldwork and community governance to the pilot, including how public intent is negotiated and represented in a place.
contacts.first_ask: How should a community-centre pilot involve residents and staff in deciding what may be delegated and which shared activities should remain directly human?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Named as professor in Science Tokyo’s September 2026 doctoral faculty roster. Individual supervision capacity and a current invitation were not established.
contacts.unknowns: Direct current personal email was not verified. The recorded contact is an indirect departmental route. Confirm the appropriate architecture/urban-design programme, language, capacity and funding; do not infer an open intake from the past 2026 guide.

contacts.name: Yasuaki Kakehi
contacts.institution: University of Tokyo, Interfaculty Initiative in Information Studies
contacts.role: Professor; Material Experience Design / Kakehi Lab
contacts.evidence: UTokyo identifies material-driven experience design; the lab develops physical interaction and experiential prototypes and records a 2026 graduate information session.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could help design tangible, multisensory prototypes that make delegated authority and human handoff perceptible; complements an architecture supervisor.
contacts.first_ask: What material or embodied interaction prototype could make a proxy’s limited mandate and the return to human control understandable at a threshold?
contacts.supervision_evidence: Graduate faculty and a dated graduate information session are documented in Information Studies. An architecture supervision role or cross-department co-supervision arrangement was not verified.
contacts.unknowns: The recorded address is the general lab mailbox. Confirm collaborator availability, degree discipline, co-supervision rules, language and funding before treating this as an architecture PhD route.

contacts.name: Takayuki Kanda
contacts.institution: Kyoto University, Graduate School of Informatics
contacts.role: Professor of Informatics; Human-Robot Interaction Lab
contacts.category: Technical or methods advisor; possible co-supervisor
contacts.evidence: Kyoto identifies his HRI role and email. The lab invites doctoral/collaboration enquiries and reports research on perceived robot authority, venue-specific strategies and real-world field trials.
contacts.possible_contribution: Could help evaluate whether people understand delegated authority and when robots should yield or hand off; strong empirical complement to architectural design research.
contacts.first_ask: How would you test comprehension of a robot/proxy’s authority and human handoff in a real civic-building threshold, while comparing the spatial arrangements?
contacts.supervision_evidence: The HRI lab explicitly welcomes prospective doctoral and collaboration enquiries. Its doctoral home is Informatics; no architecture or cross-university co-supervision approval is established.
contacts.unknowns: Architecture needs its own disciplinary anchor. Confirm current capacity, collaboration/co-supervision rules, technical background, funding, language and site feasibility.
